name: fractional-cto-toolkit
description: Operational toolkit for freelance and fractional CTOs — contracts, project-takeover SOPs, a process-engineering pipeline (standardize → automation-triage → SOP authoring with executable output), and a requirements-first pipeline (PRD/SRS per ISO/IEEE 830 + ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 → OpenSpec derived → Linear Bilingual issues → /opsx-* workflow) for client onboarding, technical audits, and vendor evaluation.
